body: Johnny Joestar, if your heart hesitates... do not shoot. Listen to me clearly... If your heart is hesitating, then you must not shoot. For then, the gates to a new path will open for you.
work: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run

body: One day I would be a better hand at the game. One day I would learn how to laugh. Pablo was waiting for me, and Mozart too...
If I could just forget what happened that night - the pain, even for a second. This time, it can be different. It has to.
If your heart is hesitating, do not shoot. You will grow... And once again, the gates leading to a 'new path' will open for you.
work: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run
